texts: Mitral atresia type is not a recognized type of DORV: C.
DORV is classified by where the VSD lies and how the great arteries relate: the VSD type (subaortic VSD) and the Fallot type (subaortic VSD with pulmonary stenosis).
The others are the TGA type (subpulmonary VSD, the Taussig-Bing heart) and the noncommitted (remote) VSD type.
Mitral atresia can occur with DORV, but it is an associated lesion, not a type.
In the picture, four signposts mark the real routes, and the mitre-welded-shut sign is crossed out.
Memory hook: four routes from the blue room; the welded mitre is not one of them.
